result:
I updated `src/exports/links.ts`. I haven't run it or any tests.

- `DownloadLink` now has `expiresAt: string`.
- `createDownloadLink` sets `expiresAt` to 7 days after creation, as an ISO timestamp.
- The URL now includes `expires=<expiresAt>`, URL-encoded, after the existing `token` parameter.

Adding `expires` to the URL doesn't make the link expire. Whatever serves the download has to check it, and the value can be tampered with unless it's signed or checked against a server-side record. I didn't touch the serving side.
